## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update / Translation addition

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code strictly adheres to the PSR-12 coding standard and includes `declare(strict_types=1);`.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All new and existing unit tests pass (`vendor/bin/phpunit`).
- [ ] PHPStan static analysis passes at level `max` with zero errors.
- [ ] If I added/changed translations, all 6 catalogs (`en`, `tr`, `de`, `ru`, `es`, `fr`) have been updated consistently.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated accordingly.
